title: Do not waste a body built for meeting
summary: This body has been given for meeting the Lord of the Universe. Let the day become an answer to that invitation.
takeaway: Use the given body as a doorway to meeting, not as a room to decorate.
lifeApplication: Choose one embodied act of remembrance, service, or restraint that says this life was given for meeting the Lord.

source.shortMeaning: The human body is given as the soul’s chance to meet Gobind.
source.lifeApplication: Before maintenance swallows the day, answer the gift with one act of meeting.

evidence.coreClaim: The human body is given as the soul’s chance to meet Gobind.
evidence.turn: The gift of embodiment becomes sacred when it is aimed toward meeting, not possession.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one embodied act of remembrance, service, or restraint that says this life was given for meeting the Lord.
